entries.subject: JWST observations of WASP-39 (programmes 1366, 2783, 5634, 8017)
entries.finding: JWST observed WASP-39 in programmes 1366, 2783, 5634, 8017 (NIRCam grism, NIRISS SOSS, NIRSpec and MIRI slitless time series). These measure the planet's atmosphere in transmission against its star; the planet is never resolved, so they give no surface image, map or colour. Not reduced here.
entries.revisitWhen: When these observations are reduced for this body, or a resolved image or map derived from them is published.
